Under this login, the system isn’t returning *any* accounts at all—not just no checking—so from the bank’s side it looks like this profile doesn’t have products linked properly.

Here are the most useful next steps you can take:

1. Quick self-checks  
   - Log out completely and log back in once.  
   - If you’re on the mobile app, try on the website (or vice versa).  
   - If you have more than one username/email with this bank, confirm you’re using the one that normally shows your checking.

2. Check for an “add/link existing account” option  
   - In many online banking portals there’s a menu like: **Settings / Profile → Accounts / Account access / Link existing accounts**.  
   - If you see your checking account listed there but not enabled for online access, enable/link it.

3. If that doesn’t work, contact support (phone or secure message)  
   Tell them something like:  
   > “I’m logged in to my personal online banking and I’m not seeing any accounts at all. I should have an existing personal checking account under this profile. Can you confirm my customer profile and make sure my checking account is correctly linked to this online banking ID?”

   If they ask for details, be ready with:
   - Your full name and DOB  
   - Last 4 of your SSN (or local equivalent)  
   - Last 4 digits of the checking account, if you have a check or debit card handy

Once support confirms your checking is visible in online banking, I’ll be able to pull your balance here. Do you want help drafting a short secure message you can paste into your bank’s message center? </action>
